text_block_list.text: When I came to pray at the shrine with Bubble Gum Fellow, who hasn't been doing well lately――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... Achoo!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
When you're out of shape, things really pile up on you.
Even a stuffy nose is giving me grief.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is that Mayano and Marvelous
over there?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo.
Visiting the shrine together, are we?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I made a wish.
That I could grow up fast!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Marvelous? What did you wish for?
Though I can kind of imagine already.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Of course, I wished for the world to become much, muuuuch more marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I knew it.
You're as grandiose as ever.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Are you having some trouble, Bubble? ☆

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I was wondering if my stuffy nose would clear up.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Did you catch a cold?
Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, that's not it.
My nose is simply acting up.
choice_data_list: Hope visiting the shrine makes things better.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, normally this is where I'd pray
to win my races, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That's something I want to handle with my own strength. It wouldn't feel right to have someone else grant it for me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So mature! So cool!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: God is definitely watching over hardworking girls like you, I'm sure of it☆

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, seeing you all
feels like it's given me some of your energy.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? That smells so good ☆
Are those dango? Such a marvelous scent of soy sauce ★

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...You're right! Then I'll treat you both.
As thanks for sharing your energy with me!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Mmm, that aroma of burnt soy sauce is just—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Now that you mention it,
I think my nose is finally clearing up...
Strangely enough, from that day forward, Bubble Gum Fellow began to regain his form.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Achoo!!
Ugh, I can't stop sneezing...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Your nose looks like it's giving you a really rough time...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Let's drop by the pharmacy, drop by☆

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Thanks. But the trouble is, it's still like this even after using nasal spray.

Bubble Gum Fellow's stuffy nose lingered for a long time,
and she wasn't able to regain her top form...
